A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''drummer''' served the [[Hutt]] siblings within the [[Hutt Clan]] syndicate known as "[[the Twins]]" in [[9 ABY]]. He played the drums in front of the Twins' litter when they went to visit [[Daimyo]] [[Boba Fett]] about the territory they laid claim to. The drummer was also with the two Hutts when they visited Fett at his [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]].

==Biography==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] served in the [[Hutt Clan]] criminal syndicate for two [[Hutt]] siblings known to many as "[[the Twins]]." At that time, [[Boba Fett]], an ex-[[bounty hunter]], took over the territories of the late [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]], a cousin of the Twins. As relatives of Jabba, the Twins laid claim to his former territories, and traveled to the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] to confront Fett. While the Hutts were carried on a platform by a litter of slaves, flanked by the [[Wookiee]] [[gladiator]] [[Krrsantan]], the drummer marched at the vanguard, rhythmically beating his drums. The drum beating caught the attention of Fett while he was at the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]] [[cantina]], the rest of the patrons also noticing the sound.<ref name="Tribes" />

[[File:TwinsDrummer-BoBFCh2.png|thumb|left|250px|The drummer presents a document supporting the Twins' claim to Jabba's territory.]]
With the drummer at the head, the Twins' group stopped before the sanctuary entrance, where Fett and his guard awaited. When the Twins' declared their claim to Jabba's territory, the drummer walked forward and took out a document for Fett to observe. Rejecting the Hutts' claim, Fett claimed they would have to kill him for the land. Not wanting to start a war, the Twins chose to depart for the time being. The drummer began beating his drum again, waiting for the Twins' litter carried platform to turn around before moving to the front and leaving with them.<ref name="Tribes" />

The Twins sent Krrsantan to [[Assassination attempt on Boba Fett|assassinate]] Fett, but the Wookiee failed and was captured as a result. On top of that, the Hutts chose to leave Tatooine after finding out that [[Mayor]] [[Mok Shaiz]] of Mos Espa had sided with another syndicate, the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. The drummer joined the Twins and their litter in visiting the Fett's [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]], formerly Jabba's palace. The man then stood there while the Hutts apologized to the Daimyo for the assassination attempt by giving him a [[Boba's rancor|rancor]] and informed him of their departure due to the arrival of another syndicate. Once finished, the Twins' litter began carrying them away, the drummer moving to their front and preparing to beat his drums.<ref name="Streets">{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The drummer was a human male with [[Color|light]] skin, black [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s. He maintained a monotone expression when doing his job.<ref name="Tribes" />

==Equipment==
The drummer wore white and beige [[clothing]] with brown [[boot]]s, a red headscarf and red and white garments over his torso.<ref name="Streets" />

==Behind the scenes==
The drummer first appeared in "[[Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine]]," the second episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'',<ref name="Tribes" /> which released on [[Disney+]] on [[January 5]], [[2022]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Murphy Patrick Martin]].<ref name="Tribes" />
